FROM FIRST ENQUIRY TO FOLLOW-UP

A process that stays together.

01 / ORGANISE

Bring the work in.

Keep customers, project details, files and quotations together. On Professional and Business, AI helps turn incoming emails and attachments into a draft schedule for checking.

02 / ESTIMATE

Quote with control.

Use your product library, material rates and mould allowances. Paste rows from Excel, review missing details and issue a branded quotation.

03 / FOLLOW THROUGH

Keep it moving.

Track revisions, record outcomes and see what needs chasing. Give your team a shared view of the work, with permissions and review steps.
